services.name: Bus Tours
services.desc: We pride ourselves in providing one of the best tour group experiences in the Black Hills. Guided tours are available upon request and knowledgeable volunteers are always available to answer questions. Discounted admission for organized tour groups of 10+ and drivers and tour escorts are free. We specialize in creating a memorable experience. We can bring in live historical entertainment and schedule a Cowboy Supper Show for a group of 30 or more to complete your Old West experience. We offer school groups a unique and educational field trip experience with our indoor and outdoor displays and hands-on activities that help students understand High Plains life.
